column2: The competent authority shall have power—

(a)
to enter into and inspect at all reasonable hours
of the day or night, any place in which workers
in any industry or service are employed, for the
purpose  of  examining  any  register  or  for
ascertaining whether the provisions of this Act
are being complied with;

(b)
where  no  such  register 
is  available  for
examination  when  he  inspects  such  place,  to
require  the  production  of  such  register  on  a
specified later date for examination at such place
or at the office of such authority;

(c)
to take copies of the whole or any part of any
such register;

(d)
to question any person whom he finds in such
place  and  whom  he  has  reasonable  cause  to
believe is an employer of workers employed in
any industry or service carried on in such place;
or
